name: great-rotunda
caption: High arcaded drum, pointed tile roof, open lantern and four small roof towers. Upper heights and pitches are adapted.
limitations: Actual model meshes; CPU alpha blending approximates the default transparent glazing. WebGL shader, frame sorting, performance and gameplay acceptance remain pending.
Source photograph is monochrome. Peach finishes, soda-green glass and terracotta hues follow the user art direction; exact historic colours remain unverified.
Crowds, exact historical exhibits, concealed services and fine sculpture are omitted. Boats, rods, marine reliefs and tank details are simplified interpretations.
Ground is review-only. Native bear source geometry/base colours retained; source projection-paint shader omitted. Vertex-colour tile variation is omitted by the CPU adapter.
Cutaways hide roofs/high walls only for review; they do not alter the runtime asset.
visualReview: Artist inspected final JPG at intended size; CPU evidence only
criteria: Pointed main cone, lantern, four smaller towers, open drum arches and gallery rail are distinct.
Barrel-tile relief, shell capitals and fish medallions visible; clerk/drum joins do not carry a cornice through the drum.
